newsitem.title: USA: Foothill Independent sets rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Foothill Independent sets rights plan.

text.p: Foothill Independent Bancorp, based in southern California, said Wednesday its board had approved a shareholder rights plan.
The plan is intended to protect shareholders from an unwanted takeover attempt, it said. The company said it was not aware of any takeover effort.

Under the plan, shareholders of record March 18 will receive one common stock purchase right for each of their shares. The rights will be exercisable if a person or group acquires or offers to acquire 15 percent or more of Foothill's outstanding shares.
